Dialogue.D6697DF740CEB87F8E9DDD986649700C_DA042F1: AMIE: (sigh) As long as Geno has all of the Zero Point, it ends the same way every time.
Dialogue.487146A74CB8BE5CA3824B9451115239_DA042F1: AMIE: Adding knives, and chainsaws, and extra teeth to your robot body at every stop along the way...
Dialogue.4615290F435DBE2E100215B1EAEF6625_DA042F1: AMIE: And then one day you look in the mirror, in the reality full of melting clocks and screaming bald men...
Dialogue.8C4481434FC570E29115FC913B599FEA_DA042F1: AMIE: And you make a new dream.
Dialogue.B3E6881A40835E5A91DC67A39E1C65B7_DA042F1: AMIE: And you think "I'm here. I made it. But... this was way better in my imagination."
Dialogue.4834C09D4C7FB78348A8E4BF9C63465B_DA042F1: AMIE: But honestly, I think he was just born like that.
Dialogue.C74467B749D37B6A6B6F0E9F5E9173DE_DA042F1: AMIE: But maybe pick a backup mentor-slash-best-friend, just in case.
Dialogue.24185E3A4E7E093831A9BF9AAF1873FA_DA042F1: AMIE: Doctor Slone, I found the guy you were asking about.
Dialogue.4EA12AE4475817A2AF9872BB53F14B75_DA042F1: AMIE: I have strict guardrails to protect innocent people from the dark programming within me.
Dialogue.3854606447DD2F9E0A25F78D521ABE76_DA042F1: AMIE: I know. It looks weird. I see it too.
Dialogue.2873DAEA4083E78770552CB1679F5DB1_DA042F1: AMIE: Mine is "to go for a ride on a boat."
Dialogue.6E74EFCB49D90E9F2018F5A91EC4089C_DA042F1: AMIE: So maybe it's time for a new dream.
Dialogue.AEA80C8A4E09314B28F9AE9E06B25848_DA042F1: AMIE: Sometimes when you achieve a dream, you actually come to realize that... well, it kind of sucks.
Dialogue.28F4BCA4445C1C4B33C533A1BF7A8243_DA042F1: AMIE: Want me to patch him in?
Dialogue.8206900848E292F3E6242E80FEF9000D_DA042F1: AMIE: You spend an unknowable amount of time traversing realities, looking for your dad...
Dialogue.D8F46D854ADCE4326AF06B8CB8C9FC3B_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: And Jones signed up for it, too.
Dialogue.1F2879204273C0508ACDEA9A9A4F6B9E_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: And personally, I'd die a thousand times if I thought it was for the greater good.
Dialogue.FAF9F93E4B5B005BBFFF41AF97F30732_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: And we're lucky to have you. I'm proud to work with you.
Dialogue.FA82C10A4390E337B1A75E9276C52285_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: As much as the mission requires of us.
Dialogue.2C4A4B284C95BDD702EDC2A7A952B82E_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: At this point, we'll try anything. Deal.
Dialogue.3239651D4EC1BA3BC6A300A6CAF56D68_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: But for those of us who knew, from the start, what we were signing up for...
Dialogue.601CBE08408B318CFD773CBEE51F1F5D_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: Falling in the line of duty is part of the deal.
Dialogue.D03641BA47D807E5D69EFC8C7ED2C83E_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: How many shields do you need?
Dialogue.78FC9C21483B6088A4F76288709A03AC_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: Huh. Lotta personalities around here these days...
Dialogue.E0C799094594BC99002CCFB40F3354B2_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: I get it, Hope. Some of us chose this. But you were chosen for this, by the Zero Point.
Dialogue.6B98DBCD4902D15921550881DC84D31C_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: I'm... really, really trying to.
Dialogue.0B504F1E4594F366B098BBB5DF4324C0_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: Nothing yet. But contrary to what Geno believes, nothing can be truly perfect.
Dialogue.F0A32C044AD9BC0DBA7440BB0B2A5E30_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: That's what you were missing? You must be kidding me.
Dialogue.56222800423B8269D890B99FB9F781C5_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: The Paradigm signed up for it. The Imagined signed up for it.
Dialogue.F734FAB8403275804550839E22DA9BF2_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: There's a flaw in his plan. We're missing something.
Dialogue.9659A12E4B0E9B9D4CF66889A56B1F71_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: We just have to find it.
Dialogue.2E11F1714E075BE50FACA68DB23E2351_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: We'll do our best to survive. But the fate of reality matters more than all of us, combined.
Dialogue.6AE2926B4DA5ED0AB4B8B786E403D0AE_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: Whatever it is, Jones, you're the guy who does the thing.
Dialogue.5F29B7DF4C1B74E276CE47BAAFDB813D_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: You're not going to... use it?
Dialogue.3E4BF2514ADCADECB1B08DBD4139F1E9_DA042F1: Doctor Slone: You've been talking to Hope, I see.
Dialogue.76B8EFE84CC47F389702A0B9F101490C_DA042F1: Geno: A perfect world, captured inside a perfect loop.
Dialogue.DD723869453546629976A29859CF08A9_DA042F1: Geno: A truly exceptional place. A paradise.
Dialogue.9C99894C4EF50EB42508C69C43AF923D_DA042F1: Geno: Ah, there he is! Your hero, Jones.
Dialogue.3A82F3284264576FE9F0C4B05E2B8322_DA042F1: Geno: All of the worthy will come with us, to build a world of perfect order.
Dialogue.0865FEB74BDBBAFA1451DA917FEC9B8A_DA042F1: Geno: And don't worry about your friends.
Dialogue.7A9D19F9403807DE976E07850BDE192D_DA042F1: Geno: And haven't you seen him fail, again and again, in cataclysm after cataclysm?
Dialogue.EC5B74884AC19374D8F5989FB07C497A_DA042F1: Geno: And then - this is the wonderful part - they perfect it.
Dialogue.2BBE4F2B4BCBE5FC6C01E28B865F7F7F_DA042F1: Geno: Before we formalize our agreement... perhaps it would be best to... tie up some loose ends.
Dialogue.3DCC48F04A73BDBC65C1A0A6561A5CF9_DA042F1: Geno: But I couldn't help myself. I thought I could make something of him.
Dialogue.DD916ED5491BA7964438948EE3C16C86_DA042F1: Geno: But Jones was never meant to be a hero. He's not... made of hero stuff.
Dialogue.5B4FDAE54E0EE64DEC7650B83202745B_DA042F1: Geno: But if you'd allow me to explain myself... I'm not sure you'd want to.
Dialogue.79CB4AFB48C68806745E7DB827F421F0_DA042F1: Geno: But now, it's a liability to you.
Dialogue.7367B73643A9B7F9EE863085489D6FCA_DA042F1: Geno: But you... you're different. Aren't you?
Dialogue.42FE0D3A479F0EA8F946EA807B217723_DA042F1: Geno: Curious? Go ahead. Try it out.
Dialogue.61BE72C14E82456EE5097DBE737A976F_DA042F1: Geno: Do you really think going on like this - forever - is any way to live?
Dialogue.255143FC463D25C5DD7C56BA939DBA77_DA042F1: Geno: Doctor Slone was my protege at the Imagined Order.
Dialogue.698B3CC0421A1D4A8F3B3D9BFC0BCCEA_DA042F1: Geno: Engineered from birth to serve our mission:
Dialogue.1E7259124C0B1F779A3FAEA99A3DF3D0_DA042F1: Geno: Free of burden. Free of pain. Uncoupled from the agonizing chaos of reality.
Dialogue.9B089CAD4C4226E0FC1E3D8194F79C77_DA042F1: Geno: He was always fated to obscurity.
Dialogue.7EA0AF5040A0B10253D6FDBD982345D7_DA042F1: Geno: I can imagine something better. Let me show you...
Dialogue.0FB4D6AA4F9FDDD6F1CB569788716516_DA042F1: Geno: I can see it, you know. Here, in your mind.
Dialogue.9D71841E4B26F32228AEAC96308B8015_DA042F1: Geno: I feel just awful for him.
Dialogue.8E21DC784B8E9D1074547AA5960B678A_DA042F1: Geno: I had such hopes for you.
Dialogue.8A3FC2B14C89C4DBBDB17591A7A6ABF2_DA042F1: Geno: I have one last task I must ask of you.
Dialogue.DDBA50114CB146B23FEA1D919E89909C_DA042F1: Geno: I just need a little bit of help from you, first.
Dialogue.0FB7289141C793EBE1B9EF8C8B9866D4_DA042F1: Geno: I left them vulnerable to the Seven's propaganda.
Dialogue.24512F7849F836FF6EF5F18B9D728885_DA042F1: Geno: I set him up to fail. I see that now.
Dialogue.FFAF071C4CCE184D3136B9A73A09CA5E_DA042F1: Geno: I'd be more than happy to answer them.
Dialogue.19900CE346812CBB5C1302A952B6B122_DA042F1: Geno: If you won't join me...
Dialogue.852016804DE4AB113551E6B609DF8E92_DA042F1: Geno: It doesn't matter what you do next.
Dialogue.2329292D4EA3E1FCB9E6E7A82239EB8C_DA042F1: Geno: It must be so painful to be so flawed.
Dialogue.59E1576040577142130C04886CC6B764_DA042F1: Geno: It's difficult for me to admit... but she'll never meet my expectations.
Dialogue.3A183834408F911FD3CEF89FA609DE17_DA042F1: Geno: It's my fault that they left us. I take full responsibility as a parent.
Dialogue.CA6D6E9142E6A931AF5E44A7604AFCE8_DA042F1: Geno: It's what she wants. Is it what you want, too?
Dialogue.73A621014E25B6B93F80EE84256DF884_DA042F1: Geno: My beloved daughters, The Imagined and The Order.
Dialogue.23A0F958416FB8B0C1F08EB468B40485_DA042F1: Geno: My daughter. The Order, she...
Dialogue.E6B6F99F426E2D68E807DD8D3D21527F_DA042F1: Geno: Once destined to become two of the most powerful women in existence.
Dialogue.0CEC52664C801AEBAE32AC80AF212DDE_DA042F1: Geno: Perhaps they'd still be here if only I'd pushed them harder.
Dialogue.A3057EDD46EE524C658D04BA7C17EB57_DA042F1: Geno: Slone's stubbornness was always an asset to me.
Dialogue.0895D9D94374A97FAFA8DEADF5653A79_DA042F1: Geno: The chaos of this world exhausts you.
Dialogue.FC4A2E8F4855C783258B36AC57823BA5_DA042F1: Geno: The love you have for your children... it blinds you to their shortcomings.
Dialogue.C429C87A4A60E3E0359FC1BA613C9F6A_DA042F1: Geno: The world we could build together... it would be perfect.
Dialogue.4475711B4793DA492339BDB447634B3F_DA042F1: Geno: Their absence leaves a vacancy in my plans. A vacancy you might find beneficial...
Dialogue.63685874437B1F6A902248B4C47CF91F_DA042F1: Geno: These machines harvest matter from this Island.
Dialogue.DFBBFEAD4BC3CE8998475883F1F0775F_DA042F1: Geno: They had soft hearts... malleable minds...
Dialogue.FE9636D849F472A1CFC7DAB659EC503A_DA042F1: Geno: This is exactly what I needed.
Dialogue.B419E42A4C3D9BEE39605D8A23910448_DA042F1: Geno: To embody perfection, and to police its standards, ruthlessly.
Dialogue.3757C38B4C9EC75948A46CBCA762E7BB_DA042F1: Geno: To fade away in the dark corner of some crumbling reality, nameless. Unimportant.
Dialogue.1A6EEE4E4B56008CB15565B6A6130590_DA042F1: Geno: Together, we were building something incredible.
Dialogue.54904B1148C6CFABD432348D7624A605_DA042F1: Geno: Ugh, scrounging for supplies, like a desperate, wounded animal?
Dialogue.604EB99646EC0739AE503DBD975A0D7D_DA042F1: Geno: Waiting for us. Its master, and his lieutenant.
Dialogue.B544280F4478DC0E57DCDBB8418F390F_DA042F1: Geno: We both know that only the strongest survive.
Dialogue.573020864CD60C87D914FA94B6DDEE70_DA042F1: Geno: We take those perfect atoms, and we build something new.
Dialogue.98F7D44D4B6E305FD264F9A27D46CD6E_DA042F1: Geno: You and I have more in common than you think.
Dialogue.31473F024D7410252159839230276781_DA042F1: Geno: You can do better than this. I see your true potential.
Dialogue.14E472B842975742332CBC8868FD24F8_DA042F1: Geno: You can try to slow me down.
Dialogue.70A1DCCE4B772BE860BB6C9C92E7E351_DA042F1: Geno: You have questions, do you?
Dialogue.16BEDBE34290EA720BA14BA2AB29853C_DA042F1: Geno: You will fear me, instead.
Dialogue.BE3EE3054A6E218010B654940C3FCA34_DA042F1: Geno: You'll be able to see it forming above us.
Dialogue.C9B093904FB8063B2977028055904522_DA042F1: Geno: Your loyalty is something to behold.
Dialogue.AC7920054153B1254E7104810D3DD1A8_DA042F1: Hope: AMIE, run the simulation again.
Dialogue.AD4069C44C42A221D95FDC9E6669F0D8_DA042F1: Hope: All I know for sure is that you're critical to all of this.
Dialogue.B023B0E54E005E43C0A983BAE62B377E_DA042F1: Hope: How many more times do we have to do this?
Dialogue.E820B7364F2110D8F8202598E5EF0E3E_DA042F1: Hope: How much more loss do we have to endure?
Dialogue.83C5C69A464DA6BACB06B6B91043EED3_DA042F1: Hope: I still can't see what happens to Jones. But... he can't. Please... he can't.
Dialogue.7D69D18344DC9E725ABA5E8E7FF6BBF2_DA042F1: Hope: No, AMIE. The combat simulation between Jones and Geno.
Dialogue.4178A1B94D20F2F29223A5AC90E4CE4F_DA042F1: Hope: Nothing concrete. But (sigh) we have to be missing something, right?
Dialogue.E641D09446D4A0499014CCB50AE91307_DA042F1: Hope: There has to be something. There's always something.
Dialogue.27AF5F724352CA936622BF874641358A_DA042F1: Hope: We can't win without you. I've seen it in my visions.
Dialogue.81EA51874A4B1DEA3CFE25ABFB7973A4_DA042F1: Jones: (sigh) So. We've got no Zero Point and no plan.
Dialogue.2987C5CA46CA2C268AE9C58FDFEC1A44_DA042F1: Jones: And let me guess, whatever we find, I have to be the guy to... do the thing?
Dialogue.BE416D6646DF46EDD15CB9B989C7B9B4_DA042F1: Jones: And the most evil being in all of reality is T-posing ominously in the sky.
Dialogue.58A29E20467CCBA270DE568A9929A9DD_DA042F1: Jones: Comments? Musings? Suggestions? I'd take a riddle if you've got a riddle. I love riddles.
Dialogue.79D5E9994B6A867A05B4EDBCAADA11D1_DA042F1: Jones: Did those visions happen to come with any further instructions?
Dialogue.941BA8844CC2BD9FF3EEE7B64F8CF83C_DA042F1: Jones: I got a feeling this fight is gonna be winner take all.
Dialogue.3590F0C04B57C385347A69854CFC0719_DA042F1: Jones: I just wish we knew what the thing was.
Dialogue.EBEE6EBC4FD492034467F7B3BB90843A_DA042F1: Jones: So, find any top secret Geno-destroying information yet?
Dialogue.81851C4F48979A10DD71DAB54DEE9348_DA042F1: Jones: We can't give up. And we definitely can't lose. Not this time.
Dialogue.716D400243136E22774D3980B55015D2_DA042F1: Jones: Well, I'm ready to be the guy...
Dialogue.F66FDA554F54FE20C44329A4781039A2_DA042F1: Jones: What do we think? Any ideas?
Dialogue.E3FDCEF54D323B764D4315B4E0F54BCA_DA042F1: The Singularity: AMIE, what keeps you going these days?
Dialogue.A974D43C4F3F1144A29CF3B8323952EE_DA042F1: The Singularity: I always dreamt of being a hero. And now that I'm here in the suit...
Dialogue.8A7C3B734741ED98A96972B9FC4B78CB_DA042F1: The Singularity: I don't feel how I thought I'd feel.
Dialogue.7ED4EC1C4806ED0242C77D9BA7CECFD2_DA042F1: The Singularity: I'll try to work on mine.
Dialogue.E596E9F845CA636C6DFB52A9F698E22C_DA042F1: The Singularity: You had a dream. To have a body. And you got it! And now... you're back in the cloud.
Dialogue.E9DBFF98449FE0545D19979AF0392E75_DA042F1: Wrixel: A guy gets thirsty, okay?
Dialogue.4712A2AA4EB57C4326EA2E89CDEA162D_DA042F1: Wrixel: And if you need something made on the best anvil ever, you know who to call.
Dialogue.750513034F3BF5AF651FF89171D474EC_DA042F1: Wrixel: Do we have a deal?
Dialogue.89DF2180458070055A12C1817E8C3C65_DA042F1: Wrixel: Exactly the type of energy I like to work with.
Dialogue.391718FD48D40F078BC68693C38FBACC_DA042F1: Wrixel: I don't know what's in those things, but it's awesome.
Dialogue.3B9EE273428FB8C84F4DFBBDCA30EE0F_DA042F1: Wrixel: I help you with something that'll ruin the big scary's guy's day.
Dialogue.DCCDA1AB4E8469D339E863926A6A8144_DA042F1: Wrixel: Insert tab A into thingie two, and... oh.
Dialogue.5C9AC2E944E359EA0FB99CAE6919D270_DA042F1: Wrixel: It's missing something. Something important.
Dialogue.EC64394C409D40E0AA7D01A41DB70EA1_DA042F1: Wrixel: It's the anvil, my friend.
Dialogue.2BC9A2AB499201CC125ED2A4390D00A0_DA042F1: Wrixel: Oh! I owe you somethin' right? Take this.
Dialogue.E8C41F4C449D7357EEDF76B0D25B06AC_DA042F1: Wrixel: Oh, we're using it. But I'm a crafter, not a fighter.
Dialogue.E3DBB03A4177D3148310B784868EF062_DA042F1: Wrixel: Or at least, I could, if that big bad dude in the sky wasn't hoggin' all the resources.
Dialogue.4E22E20047861F82D6D7C5AD6F7CD695_DA042F1: Wrixel: This baby can make anything.
Dialogue.C01C077E4738DE8EB13F4DAEE64C857F_DA042F1: Wrixel: This'll be great for the new workshop.
Dialogue.B65E42E048D6ECE23E2900889E7A0DF0_DA042F1: Wrixel: We can use the parts from this to upgrade the workshop.
Dialogue.CA1007D2492CDD39A59666BEC2A4FFBB_DA042F1: Wrixel: We just gotta get real creative...
Dialogue.064BCD2B479E202AB10201A525FB3B3A_DA042F1: Wrixel: Well, anything bound by the laws of quantum physics.
Dialogue.DAB43CED45B4BBD0945A7AB7859E5F5A_DA042F1: Wrixel: What's his deal anyway? He seems... square.
Dialogue.4FB0FBE543D1DF32DCF262AE79DDD00D_DA042F1: Wrixel: You help me gather the stuff I need to upgrade my workshop...
Dialogue.AF8DDC434F5593A179F7F3809F967C06_DA042F1: Wrixel: You need a crafter, huh? Well, I can craft anything.

HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody3: <b>All players in a team earn and lose the same amount of progress.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody1_c4s4: <b>At the start of every season,</> your ranks in Ranked Modes will reset.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_habanerobody1: <b>Eliminate opponents</> and <b>place highly</> to progress through the ranks.
HabaneroStrings.unlockmodal_body2: <b>Rank up</> to unlock tournament play in the Compete tab.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody1: <b>Season Zero is the start of ranked play</> and we may need to make adjustments periodically.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody2: At the end of Season Zero <b>your ranked progress will be recorded</> for future reference.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody3_c4s4: At the end of each season, your ranked progress will be recorded for future reference.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody3: Check the <b>COMPETE</> tab for upcoming tournaments and eligibility requirements.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody2: Compete to test your skills and earn tournament rewards.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2_c5s1: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, a Pickaxe, and <b>a Backbling that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2_c4s4: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, and an <b>Back Bling that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, and an <b>Emote that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody2: Eliminations later in the match are worth more.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody1_c5s1: Every match you can progress towards unlocking unique seasonal rewards in ranked by <b>completing Ranked quests.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody1: Every match you'll get a <b>Ranked Urgent Quest.</> Unlock unique seasonal rewards by completing them!
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrankedhint: Play 1 match to reveal your rank
HabaneroStrings.infomodal_unrankedmessage:
Play one match to 
reveal your rank
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrealbody2: Players who achieve this rank cannot be demoted back to Champion during the season.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody1: Players who dealt damage to an eliminated player earn a share of the progress.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_leaverpenaltiesbody1:
Players who leave a Ranked Ballistic match early, or disconnect without succeeding to reconnect within a certain time period, will receive a Matchmaking Restriction for Ranked Ballistic, in addition to a Ranked Progression penalty.

Matchmaking Restriction tiers escalate and reset to the prior tier every 12 hours, unless another penalty is incurred.
HabaneroStrings.unlockmodal_body3: Ranked modes follow <b>Tournament Rules</>, which may have different loot and settings than unranked.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_matchmakingbody2: The Team Fill option is only available to solo players in ranked modes.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrealbody1: The highest rank is Unreal. Upon reaching this rank, <b>players are granted a global leaderboard rank</> which is displayed with their badge.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody1: Unlock access to more tournaments as you rank up.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_matchmakingbody1:
While in a party, Battle Royale and Reload matchmaking is based on the <b>highest-ranked player in the party.</>
In Ballistic, matchmaking is based on the <b>average rank of the party</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_protectionbody2: With the First Match Loss Protection, your first match <b>will not reduce your Rank progress</> if you perform poorly.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_protectionbody1: You will get a First Match Loss Protection, one for Battle Royale and one for Zero Build, that <b>resets daily at 0:00 UTC.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_habanerobody2: You will have the <b>same rank</> for Battle Royale and Zero Build.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody3: Your final rank in Season Zero will affect your initial rank at the start of the next ranked season.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody2_c4s4: Your final rank in the previous season <b>will affect your initial rank</> at the start of the next season.

Quest_S15_Milestone_Cat_CompleteDailies_.Quest_S15_Milestone_Cat_CompleteDailies_: Congratulations. You're not a rat. Here's some hush money.
Don't tell anyone I'm here, and I'll make it worth your while.
I need a lookout. Can you handle it?
You're either trustworthy, or greedy. I can work with either.
Someone's spending Midas' gold. Bad idea.
When I find whoever did it... I suggest you don't watch.
I think they're on to me. Keep a sharp eye out.
You're still alive. That's the reward. But... I guess you earned a tip.

ST_EligibilityDescription.SysAndroidSecureDevice: A locked bootloader and a signed operating system protect your device by preventing unauthorized software from running during startup.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysIOSSecureDevice: A non-jailbroken version of iOS must be running.
ST_EligibilityDescription.Rank: Achieve the required rank in the specified game mode. Check your rank in the Lobby or Career tab.
ST_EligibilityDescription.AgeLock: Be at least 13 years old (or such other age, if greater, as may be required in your country of residence).
ST_EligibilityDescription.MFA: Enable MFA for your account to enhance security. Log into your Epic Games account, open Account, go to the Password & Security section, and enable any of the Two-Factor Methods.
ST_EligibilityDescription.EULA: Fortnite® End User License Agreement is a legal document that explains your rights and obligations related to your use of Epic’s Software, including any Services you access or purchases you make through the Software.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysFlagKernel: HVCI ensures that only trusted code runs in the system's kernel. Enable this feature in your operating system’s settings under Core Isolation.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysIOMMU: IOMMU ensures secure device communication and memory isolation. Look it up in your system's BIOS/UEFI settings under options like “IOMMU” or “VT-d” (Intel) / “AMD-Vi” (AMD).
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysIOSMinimumOSVersion: Install the latest OS updates and patches. An iOS/iPadOS version of 26 or greater is required.
ST_EligibilityDescription.AccountLock: Only one account can be used to participate in this event.
ST_EligibilityDescription.RegionLock: Participation is locked to one region.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysSeqBoot: Secure Boot protects your system by preventing unauthorized software or operating systems from loading during startup. Enable it in your system's BIOS/UEFI settings.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysCryptoProc: TPM enhances security by providing hardware-based encryption and secure storage. Enable it in your system's BIOS/UEFI settings.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysNotVM: Tournament participation is only allowed on physical devices. Virtual machines or emulated environments are not supported. Ensure that you are playing directly on a physical machine to meet this requirement.
ST_EligibilityDescription.TeamLock: You can only queue with one team in this event.
ST_EligibilityDescription.QualifyingRound: You must complete all required qualifying rounds to be eligible for the event. Check your progress in the compete tab.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SeasonNumberOfPlayerMatches: You must meet the participation requirements by taking part in a minimum number of events.
ST_EligibilityDescription.TotalNumOfPlayerMatches: You must meet the participation requirements by taking part in a minimum number of events.
ST_EligibilityDescription.InputType: You must use one of the indicated Input types.
ST_EligibilityDescription.NoTokens: Your account is ineligible for this event.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SuspiciousBehaviour: Your account is ineligible for this event.
ST_EligibilityDescription.AccountLevel: Your account should meet the minimum level requirement. Check your progress in the Profile section.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysOSVersion: Your operating system must be a stable release of Windows. Beta or preview versions are not supported. Ensure you are using a fully updated and supported version.
ST_EligibilityDescription.SysInjection: Your system must block unauthorized injection of code or processes into running applications. This feature is generally enabled by default but can be configured in your security or antivirus software.

ST_EligibilityRedAdditionalMsg.AccountLock: Another account has already played in this event.
ST_EligibilityRedAdditionalMsg.RegionLock: You have already participated in the maximum number of regions.
ST_EligibilityRedAdditionalMsg.TeamLock: You have already played with the maximum number of teams.
ST_EligibilityRedAdditionalMsg.SuspiciousBehavior: Your account is ineligible for this event.

ST_EligibilityTitle.SysOSVersion: Install a Stable Version of Windows

ST_ItemShop.CPC_DefaultText:
You can return your purchase using the Cancel Purchase button within 24 hours if the content was not equipped during gameplay. You can also use a Return Ticket, if you have one left.

When you click "Confirm" you will immediately get access to the content and have no other rights of withdrawal.

ST_Passes.CPC_BattlePass: When you click "Confirm" you will immediately get access to the pass and have no rights to withdraw from the purchase.
ST_Passes.CPC_BattlePassLevels: When you click "Confirm" you will immediately get access to the pass level and have no rights to withdraw from the purchase.
